verdict.rationale: An official iOS app is clearly evidenced: an Apple App Store listing describes account linking, action approvals, notifications and agent tasks, and the homepage says to use 'the Muse app on mobile, Mac, or directly in WhatsApp.' Nothing in the pack confirms an Android app, since 'mobile' is never broken down by platform, so only half the story is delivered. Missing for 10: evidence of an official Android app (e.g., a Google Play listing), confirmation of feature parity across mobile platforms, and independent hands-on corroboration of the mobile app's capabilities.
